plan: OpenVibe End-to-End Realignment & Implementation Plan, revision 3 (20 Sep 2026)
works: plans, immutable plan versions, perks, product bindings, member preferences and gated-resource rules in VIP's own SQLite
entitlement projection fed by Billing events (signed webhook + openvibe-sdk inbox) with valid_until, grace and a direct Billing fallback; 'unknown' never authorizes
checkout hand-off and cancellation through OpenVibe.Billing; the membership is filed under the plan version chosen
API /api/v1 for service and user tokens; consumer client openvibe-vip/client that fails closed
server-rendered creator plan pages, terms history, member status and creator dashboard with the shared chrome
import of Live's subscription offering, memberships from Billing entitlements
not_yet: not deployed; openvibe.vip is still an OpenVibe.Sites placeholder
vip.* capabilities and the service manifest are proposals, not in an openvibe-contracts release
Live, Chat and Community do not call VIP yet (consumer integration is the next step)
Billing sells one channel subscription per member and creator: one purchasable plan per creator, no tiers, no network membership product
